nodes.title: Impossible-State Gate

nodes.title: Calibrated Confidence Gate
nodes.sub: Node/agent emit a distribution (mean+variance+multimodality), not a point; fail-closed on high variance / multimodal / sparse-neighborhood even if the point value looks right.

nodes.sub: Intent → formalized spec → consistency-check → auto-generate the acceptance tests. No consistent spec ⇒ no green. Kills false-green by construction.

nodes.title: Tail + Coverage Scoring
nodes.sub: Score precision/recall on the rare/hard inputs separately with an explicit useful-threshold; enumerate the claimed state-space, fail-closed on any un-covered cell.

nodes.title: Loop Viability Governor
nodes.sub: Regulate court stringency at a viability set-point (too harsh=nothing survives, too lax=garbage) + inject a calibrated stochastic term so long build→verify→learn autoregression stays stable.

nodes.title: Verdict → Graph Writeback
nodes.sub: Every court verdict writes structured nodes back into the brain graph (self-refining), not a memory blob. From TopoMAS.

nodes.title: Juror Diversity + Confidence Vote

params.v: ensemble helps only if members competent AND diverse
